Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming
6:15 PM

For programming under ₹80,000 aim for 16 GB memory, a 512 GB SSD, and a recent Ryzen 5/7 or Intel Core Ultra 5/7 chip. Those matter more than a fancy graphics card.

Memory: 16 GB is the minimum if you run Docker, an emulator or a few browser tabs alongside your editor. Pick a laptop where it can be upgraded later.
Screen: Full HD or better, at least 14 inches, with a matte or bright panel. You'll stare at text all day.
Keyboard and battery: Try the keys in a shop if you can. Look for 8+ hours of real use, since most "up to 12 hours" claims are optimistic.
Graphics card: Skip it unless you do games or AI training. It adds weight and cost without helping normal coding.

What will you mostly build: web or app work, or heavier things like AI or games? I can then look up current prices and shortlist three.
